8 اجتزر : see 1, in two places. ―
-b2- اجتزروا فِى القِتَالِ and ↓ تجزّروا (K, TA) They fought one another [app. so that they cut one another in pieces]. (TA.) [In the K, this is immediately followed, as though for the purpose of explanation, by the words تَرَكُوهُمْ جَزَرًا لِلسِّبَاعِ أَىْ قِطَعًا: but there is evidently an omission in this place, at least of the conjunction وَ.] ―
-b3- And اجتزروا They had a camel slaughtered for them. (A.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
